data.markdown: **Investigate: Confirmed malicious host WS-FIN-0142 exhibiting new SMB lateral movement**User l.hassan initiated SMB traffic from WS-FIN-0142 to FS-CORP-03 (10.20.30.12), correlating with a prior true positive for suspicious rundll32 activity on the source host and related SMB share enumeration on the destination. This pattern indicates potential active reconnaissance or staging following confirmed compromise indicators on the same endpoint.*   **ATT&CK:** T1021.002 (Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares), T1570 (Lateral Tool Transfer) supporting lateral movement classification; zero threat intelligence matches present.*   **History:** Three related alerts in window including one prior true positive on WS-FIN-0142 and undetermined enumeration on FS-CORP-03; risk score driven primarily by historical severity (85).*   **Recommendation:** Investigate as P3 with high confidence due to correlation between confirmed malicious host history and new lateral movement signals.Validate user l.hassan's authorization for SMB access to FS-CORP-03, inspect WS-FIN-0142 for persistence mechanisms linked to the prior rundll32 alert, and review FS-CORP-03 logs for unauthorized file transfers or execution.
